CustomField.formula: IF( Days_Spent__c > Goal_Days__c , "Breached " & IMAGE("/resource/1729575807000/WrongIconImage" , "No image", 20, 20), IF( Days_Spent__c <= Goal_Days__c, "In Compliance " & IMAGE("/resource/1729575807000/RightIconImage", "No image", 20, 20), "" ) )
CustomField.label: SLA Status
